🆕 NEW RELEASE: Sick Visor share new single "'06 Camry"

Brisbane pop-punk band Sick Visor have shared the single "'06 Camry", recorded with Frenzal Rhomb's Jason Whalley producing. It is the first song from a debut album the band plans for 2027, and it looks back at singer Alex Moses moving to Melbourne.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Weezer add Europe and UK dates to The Gathering tour

Weezer extend The Gathering World Tour to Ireland, the UK and mainland Europe in May and June 2027. The 13 announced shows run from Dublin to Helsinki, with arena stops in London, Paris and Amsterdam, and no date in Germany.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Donots and South Arcade join Wacken Open Air 2027

Wacken Open Air has added Donots and South Arcade to its 2027 lineup, bringing two pop-punk and punk acts to a festival best known for heavy music. The festival runs from 28 to 31 July 2027 in Wacken, Germany.
